name: Operacija «Spadok konstruktora»
source:
At six in the morning, in a small room of his apartment block, Nazar opens his eyes and immediately understands that something is going to go wrong today. The measured life is replaced by intensive preparation, and now the countdown to an unforgettable space adventure begins - an expedition to the lost city of Zhytomyr, in search of the only thing that will save humanity.

[Translated from [url=https://denilesko.itch.io/spadokkonstruktora]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
早上六点，在自家公寓的一个小房间里，纳扎尔睁开眼睛，立刻意识到今天要出问题了。刻苦的生活被密集的准备所取代，现在一场难忘的太空冒险倒计时开始了——前往失落的日托米尔城进行探险，寻找唯一能够拯救人类的东西。

[译自[url=https://denilesko.itch.io/spadokkonstruktora]itch.io[/url]]
